mintAuthority.summary: AUSD native issuance is governed by Agora's EVM MINTER_ROLE family and the Solana Token-2022 mint authority; the EVM LayerZero BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE/adapter is bridge-only and is reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk. Agora EOAs separately hold EVM role-administration, rate-limit management, and custom transparent-proxy upgrade authority; no multisig was found on these reviewed native paths. Checkpoint 328966924 Sui GraphQL additionally locates the native AUSD TreasuryCap within shared ManagedTreasury 0x640da8eca8a239a9e26ea9a5c84e4ca526fd6c89a74218aef8672faff3a7baa5. Its typed role table records AdminRole 0x7261eebea7234185a08d14ca9a4c48075c2296196a030acd73e6a41f9401524a with time_locked=false and MinterRole 0x8954386b62c0ae248b1765f3f011a51f3b79431e044c1286e49437d2b29267a0 with the raw configuration values mint_limit=20000000000000 and duration_ms=434000000. That minter address also has PauserRole and FreezerRole. These state records do not establish private-key scheme/custody or deployed-package upgrade authority; do not infer a multisig or immutable cap.

controls.label: AUSD EVM MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: At Ethereum block 26095806, getAmountCanBeMinted(address) returned currentAmountInFlight=0 and amountCanBeMinted=15000000000000 atomic units for this minter. getMintRateLimit(address) returned limit=15000000000000 and window=28800 seconds. The separate RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE can change these parameters; this is a rolling operational limit, not an immutable economic supply cap.
controls.evidence: Pinned Ethereum block 26095806 enumerates this sole MINTER_ROLE member and eth_getCode returns 0x for it. Verified implementation ABI names getAmountCanBeMinted(address)'s first return currentAmountInFlight and second return amountCanBeMinted; the two words are 0 and 15000000000000, respectively. The getter must not be decoded as a single zero-capacity return. RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE, not the minter, controls rate-limit settings. The August review below is retained as a historical observation and does not describe current capacity.

controls.label: AUSD EVM RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712131, getRateLimitManagerRoleMembers() still returned only this code-empty EOA. Verified implementation source permits RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE to replace minter rate limits, so it can authorize greater mint capacity but cannot mint directly.

controls.label: AUSD EVM role administrator and proxy-admin owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712131, getAccessControlManagerRoleMembers() still returned only this EOA. AUSD.proxyAdminAddress() returned AgoraProxyAdmin 0xb8fcc66d613e5f54ee6a425ddbf4a2fdbe4dedee, whose owner() also returned this EOA. It can grant minter and rate-limit-manager roles and replace mint-critical implementation logic.

review.evidence: Fresh Ethereum RPC at block 25712131 still enumerated one MINTER_ROLE holder, one BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE holder, one RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE holder, and one ACCESS_CONTROL_MANAGER_ROLE holder; both mint routes reported zero currently available rolling capacity, while the manager can restore or raise limits. The custom proxy getter and AgoraProxyAdmin owner resolve to the same access-control EOA. At finalized Solana slot 438046518, the Token-2022 mint authority remained EARe2..., with the recorded freeze authority and permanent delegate. Agora's transparency index lists Grant Thornton monthly reserve attestations. The OCC registry lists Agora National Trust Bank only as a pending application, while Agora Bermuda Limited's terms state that it holds a BMA Digital Asset Business Act Class F license. The Grant Thornton May 2026 report examines reserve value against AUSD in circulation at two month-end observation dates, supporting periodic reconciliation. Under the existing Pharos evidence-scoped ruling, BMA stablecoin-specific guidance plus the Class F license supports prudential supervision. Issuer-controlled rate limits and mint roles remain economically unbounded because the manager and role administrator can restore, raise, or replace capacity. The EVM BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE holder is the LayerZero MintBurnOFTAdapter and is bridge-only; its burn/mint, pause, peer, rate-limit, owner, and adapter upgrade surfaces are retained in bridgeRouteRisk rather than counted as native Mint Authority. The native EVM and Solana controls, posture, cap semantics, reconciliation, and supervision are unchanged by that boundary correction.
